diag.optimization.label: Optimization:
diag.core_broken: Core files are damaged — usually caused by antivirus.
diag.exclusion_hint: To prevent this, add this folder to the antivirus exclusions:
diag.defender_path: In Windows Defender: “Virus & threat protection” → “Manage settings” → “Exclusions” → “Add” → “Folder” (names may differ).
diag.conflicts.title: Similar programs
diag.conflicts.note: They may intercept the same traffic and interfere with optimization.
diag.vpn.note: With a VPN, optimization is usually not needed and the strategy search may be wrong.
diag.findings.title: What else may interfere
diag.findings.empty: Checked when the page is refreshed.
diag.discord.title: Discord takes long to connect
diag.discord.note: After a strategy change, Discord may remember failed attempts. Only temporary files are deleted — sign-in and settings are kept.
diag.service.process: runs from the app, no service
diag.core.missing: not found — possibly removed by antivirus
diag.core.no_helper: checked by the helper — it is not installed
diag.core.helper_down: checked by the helper — it is not responding
diag.timestamps.off: off — will be turned on when optimization is turned on
diag.conflict.name: {owner}
diag.conflict.stop_flowseal_service: Run service.bat from the Flowseal folder as administrator → “Remove Services”.
diag.conflict.stop_flowseal_window: Close the minimized “zapret: general (…)” window on the taskbar.
diag.conflict.stop_service: Stop the “{name}” service (Windows Services) or remove it with the program that installed it.
diag.conflict.stop_process: Close the program that started this process.
diag.find.bfe.title: BFE service
diag.find.bfe.bad: not running — optimization will not start without it. Turn on the “Base Filtering Engine” (BFE) service or check the antivirus.
diag.find.proxy.title: System proxy
diag.find.proxy.on: on ({server}). Optimization may not work through a proxy — turn it off if it is not needed.
diag.find.adguard.bad: running — it also intercepts traffic. If sites do not open, turn off HTTPS filtering in it or close it.
diag.find.services.title: Network services
diag.find.services.bad: running: {list}. They intercept traffic — if optimization does not work, turn them off.
diag.find.svc_killer: Killer Network (network utilities of Dell/MSI laptops)
diag.find.folder.title: App folder
diag.find.folder.onedrive: located in OneDrive ({path}) — synchronization may lock core files. Move the app, for example, to C:\Program Files.
diag.find.folder.non_ascii: the path contains Cyrillic or other non-Latin letters ({path}) — the core may fail to start. Move the app to a folder with a Latin name.
diag.find.hosts.bad: there are YouTube lines from another program: {lines}. They may keep YouTube from opening — remove them from the hosts file.
diag.err.copy_busy: Could not copy — the clipboard is in use by another program.
diag.discord.not_found: Discord cache not found — nothing to clear.
diag.discord.confirm: Delete the Discord cache ({size})? Only the Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache folders are deleted — sign-in, settings and messages usually remain; Discord will simply reload everything.
diag.discord.confirm_running:
Delete the Discord cache ({size})? Only the Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache folders are deleted — sign-in, settings and messages usually remain; Discord will simply reload everything.

Discord is open now — the app will close it. Start Discord again after clearing.
diag.discord.cleared_failed: Discord cache cleared: {size}. Could not delete files: {n} — they are in use.
diag.results.no_helper: Strategy search results are stored by the helper — they appear after the first search.
